title: App Builder Design Choices
description: Structured design decisions made by a person, over the ones the factory already makes. Every control has a declared set of values or a rule that decides whether a value is acceptable; this is a contract, not a stylesheet. Choices are applied over the factory's own selection at generation, so a rebuild picks up a new layout pattern without discarding how someone set the design.

accentColor.description: The brand accent. Also refused when it cannot carry the label placed on it at the contrast a reader needs, which the schema cannot express and the service checks.
